recommendation: Keep the audit commit. FHIR-13631 is satisfied by current core source and the later already-published FHIR-45727 correction; additional edits would duplicate current wording.
issue_request: FHIR-13631 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and reported that the example `GET [base]/Measure/CMS146/$evaluate-measure?patient-124&periodStart=2014-01&periodend=2014-03` was incorrect because `patient-124` was not a valid parameter form and the patient reference needed to be represented correctly.
initial_application: The Jira application comment says the change was applied at SVN 12641. In the Git mirror, commit 734c7befc75fc6677ab2dbae8d77bdc07428cc5b corresponds to SVN 12641 and changed the invalid example from `patient-124` to `subject=124` during the broader Measure/MeasureReport patient-to-subject generalization, but that historical source still left an underspecified reference and lower-case `periodend`.
additional_context: Measure is active in source/fhir.ini and the retained Measure-evaluate-measure OperationDefinition remains listed in source/measure/list-Measure-operations.xml. Later FHIR-45727, already represented on the combined branch, corrected the same patient-specific example family by requiring `subject=Patient/124`; the current combined-branch reconciliation for FHIR-45727 also fixed the remaining periodEnd casing and narrative duplicate. No relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence changed that conclusion.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current source no longer contains `patient-124`, `subject=124`, or lower-case `periodend`, and the active Measure operation example plus Quality Reporting narrative now show `subject=Patient/124&periodStart=2014-01&periodEnd=2014-03`.
